fields.why: Current control logic for recleaner con pump has the pump running to a level controller, previous controller was put in place from project PK525/WP70 for the restart, this offers no protection against the hopper level emptying. The pump currently runs in manual to maintain stable pumping.
fields.design:
Make the following changes to the control logic
- Adjust current PID loop 430-DIC-1650 to 430-LIC-1645B.
- 430-LIC-1645 will have Manual and Remote mode. Remote mode will equal 430-LIC-1645B SP + 5%.
- Tune 430-LIC-1645 pump to respond to level changes slowly avoiding sudden changes that could cause surging or instability.
- 430-LIC-1645B control loop to have min CV of 50% to ensure water is always used on the hopper.
- Maintain the function to be able to close water addition valve when changed to Manual mode.
- Review PID loop tuning on water addition control loop to avoid surges in hopper level.
- Maintain 430-LIC-1645 Min CV of 56%
- Have the following process off conditions:
 - Float feed pump 420-PP-1330 is offline
fields.impact: Recleaner con pump can run in Remote on level instead of manual.
